svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: New solutions mind map
svg.desc: New solutions: Deployment strategy: Infrastructure as code (IaC), Continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), Change management processes; Business continuity: AWS Global Infrastructure, AWS networking concepts, RTOs and RPOs; Security controls from requirements: IAM, Route tables, security groups, and network ACLs, Encryption options for data at rest and data in transit; Reliability requirements: AWS Global Infrastructure, AWS storage services and replication strategies (for example Amazon S3, Amazon RDS, Amazon ElastiCache), Multi-AZ and multi-Region architectures; Performance objectives: Performance monitoring technologies, Storage options on AWS, Instance families and use cases; Cost optimization strategy: AWS cost and usage monitoring tools, Pricing models, Storage tiering
